source: user-provided spreadsheet: JMA's list of officially-named natural phenomena (気象庁が名称を定めた気象・地震・火山現象一覧)
note: Only the typhoon-related rows (「台風第Ｎ号」 in the 期間・現象等 column) are extracted here. Era year (昭和/平成/令和) converted to the Gregorian year, combined with the storm number, to derive the 4-digit storm code used elsewhere in this repo (data/index.json's officialName field on that code).
